small_guidance: The conv_transpose3d kernel is the 98% bottleneck and is compute-bound at 72% with only 57% occupancy (register-limited at 72 regs/thread). Try: (1) reduce register pressure by hoisting `oc_offs * (KD*KH*KW)` and bias loads outside loops, and split the inner `acc += w[:,None]*x[None,:]` into accumulation via tl.dot using a small K tile so Tensor Cores engage; (2) add autotune configs with larger BLOCK_SP (128) at num_warps=4 and BLOCK_OC=32 to amortize index math; (3) the current scatter-via-gather visits every (kd,kh,kw) for every output position even when only one (kd,kh,kw) tuple satisfies the stride==0 modular constraint — restructure the inner loop to iterate only the single valid (kd,kh,kw) per output using `(od+PD) % SD` parity check upfront, cutting the inner iterations by ~SD*SH*SW=8x.
large_guidance: Redesign conv_transpose3d as an im2col-style GEMM where one program computes a tile of (OC × output-spatial) by reducing over (IC * KD * KH * KW) using tl.dot with BLOCK_M=32/64 (OC), BLOCK_N=32/64 (spatial), BLOCK_K=16/32. Key insight: for ConvTranspose with stride=2, only 1 of every stride^3=8 (kd,kh,kw) combinations contributes to a given output pixel (the one matching (od+PD) mod SD, (oh+PH) mod SH, (ow+PW) mod SW). Exploit this by precomputing per-output-tile which kernel offsets are active, OR equivalently implement as a forward-conv gather: for each output position compute exactly the (kd,kh,kw)=(od+PD) mod stride etc., then loop only IC with a single multiply, making it an IC-reduction GEMM with K=IC (very small) — pair this with channels_last input layout so IC loads coalesce. Also fuse the BN+mean-sub epilogue if shapes permit a single-pass per-(N,C) reduction.
